summary: Master energy data analytics and demand forecasting with Excel, Power BI, and practical load analysis. Build dashboards and forecast models.
lede: Energy Data Analytics and Demand Forecasting provides a structured way to turn interval readings, SCADA feeds, smart meter data, and energy management dashboards into defensible operational decisions. You will practise cleaning energy data, profiling loads, analysing baselines, adjusting for weather, estimating demand charges, and constructing forecasts that reflect changing occupancy, production, and weather patterns. The course also covers MAPE-based accuracy checks, Power BI and Excel reporting, executive dashboard design, anomaly detection logic, API-based data ingestion, and carbon-linked reporting methods at an operational level. You will build a forecast workbook and reporting pack designed for planning meetings, reporting cycles, and energy reviews, including situations where data quality is mixed and operational priorities compete.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with energy, utilities, facilities, or operational data and need to improve forecasting and reporting capability. It suits people responsible for demand planning, energy performance tracking, and evidence-based decision support across buildings, plants, grids, or portfolios.
audience: Building Performance Specialists using BMS and meter
prerequisites: Participants need access to a laptop with Microsoft Excel installed and, ideally, Power BI Desktop for dashboard exercises. No coding is required, but you should be comfortable working with spreadsheets, formulas, charts, and basic energy datasets.
